query: NIFC National Interagency Fire Center year-to-date acres burned wildfires as of mid-July 2026, latest daily figures July 11 12 13 2026, and daily burn rate increments
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of what I found on NIFC year-to-date acres burned for mid-July 2026:

## Bottom Line
- **Most recent confirmed figure:** **3,853,513 YTD acres burned / 40,357 fires** as of the July 17, 2026 report (NIFC Statistics page, updated July 18).

## Progression through mid-July (from official IMSR reports)
| Report Date | YTD Fires | YTD Acres | % of 10-yr avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| July 10 | 38,541 | 3,445,499 | 139% |
| July 12 | 38,956 | 3,578,017 | 137% |
| July 16 | 39,764 | 3,674,911 | 131% |
| July 17 | 40,357 | 3,853,513 | — |

## Daily Burn-Rate Increments
- **July 10→12:** ~66,259 acres/day avg
- **July 12→16:** ~24,224 acres/day avg
- **July 16→17:** +178,602 acres (large single-day jump)
- **Full 7-day window:** ~58,288 acres/day avg

NIFC's directly-reported **"acres yesterday"** single-day totals were: **6,183** (7/9), **7,060** (7/11), and **35,970** (7/15) — the July 15 surge driven mainly by Minnesota's Superior NF/BWCA fires (+31,096 acres in Eastern Area).

## Key caveats I resolved
1. **Dating lag:** Wayback archive capture dates lagged the actual report headers, so I verified each IMSR's internal date. The exact July 11, 13, 14 reports weren't archived, so some increments are multi-day averages.
2. **Two different metrics:** The YTD table grows faster than the "acres yesterday" line because it absorbs mapping corrections and late/SIT-209 reporting adjustments.

The 2026 season is running above normal (131–139% of the 2016–2025 average), with National Preparedness Level 4 and uncontained large fires climbing from 39 to 49 across the period.
